definition: An off response is the retinal signal that occurs when a light stimulus ends. In this source, it refers to a positive electroretinogram response linked to the retina’s OFF pathway.

reasons: The packet does not support the claim that an “off response” is “the retinal signal that occurs when a light stimulus ends.” It only discusses an “OFF-response in the electroretinogram (ERG)” in the context of evaluating OFF-pathway functions, without defining the stimulus-ending condition.
